```{r}
#| label: setup
#| results: false
source("setup.R")
fits <- get_fits()
```

# Power-scaling

```{r}
#| label: tbl-powerscale
#| tbl-cap: "Power-scaling sensitivity (priorsense)."
bind_rows(lapply(specs$model, function(m) {
  as.data.frame(powerscale_sensitivity(fits[[m]], variable = pars[[m]])) |>
    mutate(model = m, .before = 1)
})) |>
  kable(digits = 3)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-powerscale
#| fig-cap: "Power-scaling of prior and likelihood for M2b."
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 7
powerscale_plot_dens(fits$M2b, variable = pars$M2b)
```

# Alternative priors

```{r}
#| label: alt-fits
#| results: false
alt_scales <- c(narrow = 0.25, wide = 5)
alt_fits <- list()
for (m in specs$model) {
  for (a in names(alt_scales)) {
    alt_fits[[paste(m, a)]] <- fit_model(m, alt_scales[[a]], paste0("_", a))
  }
}
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-prior-alt
#| fig-cap: "Price elasticity (posterior mean and 90% interval) under narrow, baseline and wide priors."
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 4
prior_alt <- bind_rows(
  lapply(specs$model, function(m) {
    summarise_draws(as_draws_df(fits[[m]], variable = "b_log_rprice_c"),
                    "mean", ~quantile2(.x, probs = c(0.05, 0.95))) |>
      mutate(model = m, prior = "baseline")
  }),
  lapply(names(alt_fits), function(n) {
    summarise_draws(as_draws_df(alt_fits[[n]], variable = "b_log_rprice_c"),
                    "mean", ~quantile2(.x, probs = c(0.05, 0.95))) |>
      mutate(model = sub(" .*", "", n), prior = sub(".* ", "", n))
  })
) |>
  mutate(prior = factor(prior, levels = c("narrow", "baseline", "wide")))
ggplot(prior_alt, aes(mean, prior, colour = prior)) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = q5, xmax = q95)) +
  facet_wrap(~ model, nrow = 1) +
  labs(x = "Price elasticity", y = NULL) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-prior-alt
#| tbl-cap: "Price elasticity under narrow, baseline and wide priors."
prior_alt |>
  arrange(model, prior) |>
  select(model, prior, mean, q5, q95) |>
  kable(digits = 3)
```
